items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: Yeah, I know many piano players. There was George W. Thomas.

ctx.x: Yeah, that would be 19 and five about then. Do you remember any other piano players at that time that you heard? Any of their name or who they were?
Yeah, I know many piano players. There was George W. Thomas.
Oh, yeah, I've heard of him. He had some music in the company.
